leads.lead: Kalamazoo County proposes a 4.74% millage increase worth $4.49 million; public hearing Tuesday Oct 6
leads.why: The posted notice says millage 7.8354 is proposed for the 2027 budget, a 4.74% increase and $4,493,001 more revenue. The hearing is at 6:45 PM.
leads.foia: 2027 budget work papers, department requests and revenue projections behind the $4,493,001 increase.

leads.lead: County health plan: Commissioners weigh dropping or rationing GLP-1 weight-loss drug coverage after $1.5 million in 2025 spend
leads.why: The Sept 28 special-meeting packet shows anti-obesity GLP-1 spend of $1,264,000 (2024) and $1,539,100 (2025), and that a $200 copay would cost the county BCBSM rebates because plans with copays over $150 lose them. Employees are directly affected and no NowKalamazoo story on GLP-1 turned up.
leads.foia: BCBSM correspondence, rebate calculations and Plan Design Committee minutes on 2027 GLP-1 coverage, Jan 1 2025 to Sept 30 2026.

leads.lead: Comstock Township planners OK a 400 MW battery plant (CIP / Cygnet Energy) while the fire department says it needs $1.0-1.2 million of equipment
leads.why: Draft Sept 10 minutes: approval with conditions, $825 per MW per year host agreement for 20 years, $500 million investment yielding about $1 million in township tax, and the applicant offering only $100,000 for a fire analysis. Residents objected to data centers and solar at the same meeting.
leads.foia: Community host agreement, development agreement drafts, fire department resource analysis and CIP/Cygnet correspondence with Comstock Township.

leads.lead: Data center rules arrive in two places in one week: City of Kalamazoo final vote Oct 5, Comstock Township Planning Commission discussion Oct 8
leads.why: Kalamazoo is finalizing a zoning-ordinance moratorium on data centers, BESS and crypto mining. Comstock staff is circulating a sample data center ordinance while noting no project has been proposed. NowKalamazoo has covered the city; Comstock Township has no township-level stories since Jul 1.
leads.foia: Any inquiry, pre-application or NDA from a data center or crypto-mining developer received by Kalamazoo Township planning or Comstock Township, Jan 1 to Sept 30 2026.

leads.lead: Road Commission holds a $25 million federal Safe Streets grant through 2030 while residents fight its tree removals
leads.why: USAspending shows award 693JJ32540510 ($25,000,000, DOT, period 2025-09-19 to 2030-09-19) to the Board of County Road Commissioners. NowKalamazoo has covered the tree fights but no Safe Streets newsletter hit since Jul 1.
leads.foia: SS4A grant agreement, project list, obligated and spent amounts, and consultant contracts under award 693JJ32540510.

leads.lead: City Planning Commission hears a student recovery-housing permit (Frat 15 LLC, 1500 Fraternity Village Drive) and a 5-room traveler boarding house on Pearl Street, Oct 1
leads.why: Both special use permits are on the Oct 1 agenda; the recovery house is a partnership with Unified Recovery Clinics in an 8,772 sq ft former fraternity house. No NowKalamazoo story found on either.
leads.foia: Applications, neighbor notice responses and correspondence for P.C. #2026.07 and #2026.08.

leads.lead: County Public Housing Commission: Sugarloaf residents, Hays Park homes and liability insurance on Oct 1 agenda
leads.why: Agenda lists housing assistance for Sugarloaf residents, a HOPE thru Navigation proposal, an end-of-year Sugarloaf report, and old business on liability insurance for Bethany House and Keystone. Zero NowKalamazoo hits for Sugarloaf, Hays Park or the commission.
leads.foia: Insurance policies and quotes for Bethany House and Keystone House, HOPE thru Navigation proposal, and Sugarloaf resident assistance spending.

leads.lead: Kalamazoo Township residential trash hauling RFP is out; board meets Oct 6 and Oct 13
leads.why: The township site banner says a Residential Solid Waste Collection RFP is posted. NowKalamazoo covered Portage single-hauler but nothing on the township RFP since Jul 1.
leads.foia: The RFP, bids received and scoring sheets for Kalamazoo Township residential solid waste collection.

leads.lead: Local firm Seven Generations Architecture & Engineering holds multiple federal contracts, the largest $18.9 million (DoD DHA)
leads.why: USAspending shows Kalamazoo-based recipient with W912DY20C0025 at $18,928,609.50 (2020-06-28 to 2025-06-27, options value $20,753,961.98) plus Interior and DHA awards. Nothing in NowKalamazoo archive. Federal contracts, so federal FOIA, not Michigan.
leads.foia: Federal FOIA to DHA/Army Corps for the W912DY20C0025 statement of work and modifications (not a Michigan FOIA).

leads.lead: Oshtemo Township has had zero NowKalamazoo stories since Jul 1 despite regular packets
leads.why: Verified coverage: 0 posts, 3 newsletter mentions for the board since Jul 1. Planning Commission packets exist for Aug 27, Sept 10 and Sept 24; the site blocks automated reads, so it is a gap AI-assisted agenda reading would close.
leads.foia: Oshtemo Township Planning Commission and Board packets and staff memos Aug 1 to Sept 30 2026 (if the site stays inaccessible).

foia.body: Kalamazoo County (Board of Commissioners; HR Department)
foia.coordinator: FOIA agent is the Board of Commissioners, 269-384-8111, 201 W Kalamazoo Ave (per kalcounty.gov FOIA pages found via search)
foia.request: Under MCL 15.231 et seq., I request copies of: (1) all communications between Kalamazoo County Human Resources and Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan from Jan 1, 2025 through Sept 30, 2026 concerning coverage, copays, rebates or utilization of anti-obesity GLP-1 drugs; (2) the 2027 health plan design options document and cost model presented to the Board of Commissioners on or before Sept 28, 2026, including the Option 1, 2 and 3 premium tables; (3) minutes and materials of the Plan Design Committee for 2026 meetings; (4) the 2025 and 2024 prescription spend reports showing the $1,539,100 and $1,264,000 anti-obesity GLP-1 figures. Electronic copies requested. Under MCL 15.235 the body must respond within 5 business days of receipt; it may extend once by up to 10 business days with written notice; it may charge fees under MCL 15.234 and request a deposit. Request is made under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, MCL 15.231 et seq.
foia.why: Employee benefit cost decision with seven-figure drug spend and no NowKalamazoo coverage.

foia.request: Under MCL 15.231 et seq., I request: (1) the executed or draft community host agreement for the 400 MW battery energy storage system proposed by CIP / Swan Energy / Cygnet Energy, including the $825 per MW per year terms; (2) any draft development agreement for the project; (3) the Fire Department resource analysis and Chief Beauchamp's equipment list submitted Aug 1 to Sept 30, 2026; (4) all correspondence between township staff or the township attorney and CIP, Swan Energy or Cygnet Energy from Jan 1 to Sept 30, 2026; (5) the assessor's report on tax revenue and property value impact. Under MCL 15.235 the body must respond within 5 business days of receipt; it may extend once by up to 10 business days with written notice; it may charge fees under MCL 15.234 and request a deposit. Request is made under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, MCL 15.231 et seq.
foia.why: Largest private investment in the township ($500 million) with a stated fire safety funding gap.

foia.request: Under MCL 15.231 et seq., I request: (1) the executed Safe Streets and Roads for All implementation grant agreement for U.S. DOT award 693JJ32540510 ($25,000,000); (2) the project list, schedule and budget by location; (3) invoices and reimbursement requests submitted under the award through Sept 30, 2026; (4) contracts and procurement records for consultants or contractors paid from the award. Under MCL 15.235 the body must respond within 5 business days of receipt; it may extend once by up to 10 business days with written notice; it may charge fees under MCL 15.234 and request a deposit. Request is made under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, MCL 15.231 et seq.
foia.why: $25 million of federal money through 2030; recurring public concern about road commission decisions.
